source.source_rights_note: Third-party upload of Bungie's Destiny 2: The Witch Queen cutscene archive. Used only in a non-commercial fan creation under Bungie's fan-content forbearance. The repository stores metadata and timestamps, never the footage.

chapter_metadata.note: The 12 publisher chapter windows below are copied verbatim from that captured artifact as factual source data. No footage is stored; this repository never depends on the sibling at runtime.

This is the cataclysm: the great fear of the intended audience.

subtitle.text: Where the work is shaped, not wished.
A world returned, and nothing on it unchanged.
Light in the brood, doubt in the court.
Shape the tool, then trust it with the work.
Chosen is a verdict, not a wish.
The record is the memory; the memory is the proof.
Every strength is a bargain with a hunger.
In the sword logic, defeat is only data.
It watches from the dark between the stars.
Even queens keep allies beyond the reef.
Six voices enter; the discipline holds them.
